sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is semantically faithful and passes deterministic validation. It correctly targets ships, preserves the exact-one classification boundary, encodes the open-water condition with a unitless decimal concentration strictly below 1 and iceOfLandOriginPresent exactly false, and uses a SHACL Core complement for the non-open alternative without inventing classifications.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the unrequired closed enumeration of six ice-condition values, both from the top-level classification constraint and the non-open alternative. The verified requirement only conditions on classification being openWaterIceCondition; it does not authorize restricting all other classifications to these alternatives. Preserve the conditional open-water branch requiring seaIceConcentration as a unitless decimal strictly less than 1 and iceOfLandOriginPresent exactly false, and encode the non-open complement without inventing additional controlled-value obligations.

Replace the non-open-water SPARQL alternative with a SHACL Core complement, such as sh:not around a shape whose property constraint has sh:path nltl:iceConditionClassification and sh:hasValue nltl:openWaterIceCondition. The classification minCount/maxCount already supplies branch-selection evidence, and the bounded complement does not require SPARQL. Preserve the open-water branch and all its existing concentration, unit, decimal, strict-less-than, and false-value constraints; do not reintroduce a closed enumeration of non-open classifications.

Candidate is semantically faithful and passes deterministic validation. It correctly targets ships, preserves the exact-one classification boundary, encodes the open-water condition with a unitless decimal concentration strictly below 1 and iceOfLandOriginPresent exactly false, and uses a SHACL Core complement for the non-open alternative without inventing classifications.
